messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: How to plot graph in java using renjin
parts:
Hi Lalitdutt,

Most of the graphics plumbing hasn't been implementing in Renjin so you won't be able to use plot() or ggplot2.

What we generally use Renjin for is to do the computation on the server, and then send the results as json to the browser, where it can be rendered with d3.js or other tools.

Best,
Alex

Hi Alex ,
I am applying time series like :

engine.eval("n<-c(2,3,5,4,7,4,4,4,8,2,6,5,4,8,5,8,4,8,5,8,4,6,3,3,4,8,2,9,6,7,2,6)");

System.out.println(engine.eval("x"));

Output :
c(2, 3, 5, 4, 7,... 32 elements total)

  Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec
